stem: Men arrive at a clinic independently and at random, at a constant mean rate of 0.2 per minute. Women arrive at the same clinic independently and at random, at a constant mean rate of 0.3 per minute.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that at least 2 men and at least 3 women arrive at the clinic during a 5-minute period.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that fewer than 36 people arrive at the clinic during a 1-hour period.
